choices.misconception: I thought 48 x 25 - 48 x 5 cancelled to zero because both parts start with 48.
I treated 48 x 25 - 48 x 5 as 48 x (25 / 5).
I combined 48 x 25 - 48 x 5 into 48 x 30, adding instead of subtracting.
I grouped everything at once as (48 + 52) x (25 - 5 + 20).

hints: Look for a number that appears more than once.
Take out the common factor 48 from the first two products. Then you will see another common factor that pairs up with the last product.

solutions.reliable: Take out 48 from the first two products: 48 x 25 - 48 x 5 = 48 x (25 - 5) = 48 x 20. Now 48 x 20 + 52 x 20 = (48 + 52) x 20 = 100 x 20 = 2000. Check by grinding: 1200 - 240 + 1040 = 2000. The transferable idea: factor out what repeats until the numbers pair into something round.

whyOnTest: Clever regrouping: spotting common factors turns three products into one easy multiplication.
author: Devansh Sanghavi
